The evidence from Source [S2] explicitly states: 'The EDP-driven initial culling still greatly affects deeper layers, because the effect of culling in the earlier layers is propagated to deeper layers.' It also notes that EDP uses wider area occluders (more effective/precise) while UDP (the simpler technique) utilizes only a tiny pixel, implying EDP is more effective. Furthermore, it mentions that the hybrid scheme (EDP for front layers, simpler DP for deeper layers) performs similarly to simpler techniques peeled for deeper layers, supporting the effectiveness of the propagation.
